title: just-deliver catalog component
description: What a workload asks for by name (for example 'database'): one contract, and an implementation per environment type. Expressions (${...}) are kept as raw strings by the loader and evaluated later. Unique by name across components and runtimes.

name.description: Value teams write as 'type' in a workload requirement; same pattern as the workload schema's type.

description.description: What the component gives a team.

exports.description: The contract: the only valid names in ${resource.<id>.<name>}. Every class of every implementation exports exactly these (checked by the resolver).

implementations.description: Environment type (declared in the Catalog file) or 'default' -> implementation. An environment uses its type's implementation, else 'default'; every implementation declares the same classes (checked by the resolver).

classes.description: Class (what a workload may request with 'class') -> the nodes each requiring workload gets and its exports.

nodes.description: Graph nodes by name; the name is how other expressions refer to the node.

exports.description: Export name -> expression producing it; exactly the component's exports.

template.description: Template reference, relative to the catalog's templates directory.

kind.description: create (default) or grant. Grants are surfaced in the approval diff.

config.description: Template configuration. Values are any YAML scalar or map, kept as written.
